 By Sabrina Castro November 15, 2026 at 3:32 pm EST Enter Fullscreen Expand Police need help locating fugitive; AT&T offering up to $10k for information leading to his arrest By Sabrina Castro November 15, 2026 at 3:32 pm EST SOUTH FULTON, Ga. — The City of South Fulton Police is asking for the public help in locating a man who is wanted as a fugitive from justice while also being a person of interest in a theft in a separate incident. 
 [DOWNLOAD: Free WSB-TV News app for alerts as news breaks ] 
 The man is 37-year-old Brandon Chambers.
 Chambers is a fugitive from justice out of the City of South Fulton and, separately, a person of interest in the theft of telecommunications equipment from a cell tower on Nov. 11, according to police.
 AT&T is offering a reward of up to $10,000 for information leading to his arrest and conviction. 
 Police are asking that if you see him or know where he is, call 911 or contact the City of South Fulton Police Department.
 Authorities say not to approach or try to apprehend him and to report sightings immediately.
